'''Jelph Merrian's mother''' was a single mother on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. When her son, [[Jelph Marrian]] was younger, she told him stories about when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had [[Battle of Toprawa (Great Sith War)|occupied]] Toprawa during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. She abandoned her son, but he was found by [[Krynda Draay]], who eventually brought him into the [[Jedi Covenant]].
